name: Sky Joust
hook: Flap higher. Lance lower knights. Grab their eggs.
how: Flap to fly your knight on its giant bird. When two knights crash, the higher lance wins and the loser drops an egg: grab it before it hatches or they're back. Stay out of the lava and its grabbing hand. Last knight flying wins the round; first to 5 rounds wins.
controls: Arrows or A/D to steer, Space, Z or Up to flap; on touch, the arrow buttons and Flap
uses: Matches won, shown on the results card.
Bots fill the empty seats, and someone who joins takes a bot's seat next round.
The host's browser keeps the rounds and the score; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Every knight flies for everyone at once; whoever ends up lower calls their own fall.
ideas: Add a pterodactyl that hunts whoever is winning
Make the lava rise a little every round
Let me pick my bird's color before the match
